content.title: Jaskirat Singh Rangi Real Story
content.text: While Jaskirat Singh Rangi is being associated with Indian Army officers like Major Mohit Sharma, the name is likely fictionalAfter the phenomenal success of Dhurandhar, the part two, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, has got the attention of movie enthusiasts. A lot of emphasis is on the lead character Hamza Ali Mazari, played by Ranveer Singh. Dhurandhar Part II is expected to provide more details about the real identity of Hamza Ali Mazari. Many people are saying that the real person behind Hamza is actually Jaskirat Singh Rangi. Let us check out more details on Jaskirat Singh Rangi real story.Image Credit - Google GeminiWho is Jaskirat Singh Rangi?Dhurandhar focused on how Jaskirat Singh Rangi infiltrated the gang in Lyari, which was led by Rehman Dakait (Akshay Khanna). In Part II of Dhurandhar, the movie is likely to provide details on Jaskirat Singh Rangi's past life. Based on teasers, it appears that Jaskirat Singh Rangi had to face a lot of traumatic events in his young life. When he gets to know the real people responsible for the hurt in his life, he makes it his life's mission to take revenge.In his youth, Jaskirat Singh Rangi likely committed multiple murders. This was probably when members of his family were killed. While spending time on death row, Jaskirat was noticed by Indian intelligence agencies. Subsequently, he was selected by IB (Intelligence Bureau) Chief Ajay Sanyal (played by R. Madhavan) for 'Operation Dhurandhar.' Already on death row, Jaskirat decides to take up the risky job of entering pakistan and take revenge on the people that harmed his family members.More details are expected to be revealed in the sequel - Dhurandhar: The Revenge. The part two is scheduled to be released on March 19, 2026. Already, there is speculation that Dhurandhar Part 2 could generate a higher collection in comparison to the Part 1. There are also rumors that a Part 3 of Dhurandhar could also be in the making. However, there is no official confirmation.Fan theoriesThere are some interesting stories going around about the real life of Jaskirat Singh Rangi. The movie makers also seem to be adding potential Easter eggs to get the attention of the audience. For example, Dhurandhar director Aditya Dhar's earlier movie, Uri: The Surgical Strike, also had the mention of the name Captain Jaskirat Singh Rangi. In that movie, Jaskirat was from the Punjab Regiment.This has sparked speculation that Jaskirat could be part of Aditya Dhar's cinematic universe. However, a connection is difficult to establish since Jaskirat in Uri was killed in an ambush, whereas Jaskirat in Dhurandhar is shown as a criminal-turned-spy. Some people are also suggesting that Jaskirat Singh Rangi could mean JSR in short, which could be representative of 'Jai Shree Ram'. We expect more details to be revealed in Dhurandhar Part 2.DailyhuntDisclaimer: This content has not been generated, created or edited by Dailyhunt. Publisher: News Patrolling
